description: This PHP class defines a plugin for generating advertising analysis reports within the Revive Adserver platform. It includes methods for initializing report info, setting default parameters, executing report generation, and creating worksheets for daily, campaign, and zone breakdowns based on advertiser and publisher scope.

classes.name: Plugins_Reports_OxReportsStandard_AdvertisingAnalysisReport
classes.description: A plugin class for generating detailed advertising analysis reports with multiple breakdown worksheets.

methods.name: initInfo
methods.description: Initializes report metadata such as name, description, category, author, export type, and authorizations.

methods.name: getDefaults
methods.description: Prepares default report parameters based on user session preferences.

methods.name: saveDefaults
methods.description: Saves user-selected report parameters into session preferences.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Generates the report by creating worksheets based on selected parameters and scope.

methods.name: _checkParameters
methods.description: Validates that at least one breakdown worksheet is selected.

methods.name: _getReportParametersForDisplay
methods.description: Returns displayable report parameters such as date range and scope.

methods.name: _addDailyBreakdownWorksheet
methods.description: Creates the daily breakdown worksheet using scope and date range.
